# L3′ — Chronological

**MEF lens `L3′`** · Square C — Becoming `[2 + 3]`: logic ⇄ process, synchronic ⇄ diachronic · Night face · index `#3′` · tonic `G` · ground-pair **Decision** (Power-led) · twin: [L3 — Processual](L3-processual.md)

*Root:* Hegel, Aion, dialectic of Spirit · *Element:* Fire · *Möbius:* `L3′ → L2`

The same Logos/Decision rotation grounded on the Power-face: the cut written as *history* — Geist's macro-temporal dialectic, decision after decision sublated forward.

## Sublens

The six inner sublenses, each tagged with its rotated `Name[note]` / `Power[note]` (chromatic-basis note-tags):

- **L3.0′ — Spirit (Geist)** (`Decision[G]` / `Logos[F♯]`) — the self-moving totality; the living process history *is*.

- **L3.1′ — Spring** (`Love[A]` / `Son[G♯]`) — birth/emergence; the thesis, the initial positing.

- **L3.2′ — Summer** (`Work[B]` / `Image[A♯]`) — fullness; the thesis realised before contradiction appears.

- **L3.3′ — Autumn** (`Play[C♯]` / `Truth[C]`) — decline/harvest/wisdom; the antithesis meeting its limits.

- **L3.4′ — Winter** (`Need[D♯]` / `Mind[D]`) — death/dormancy; the negation that is also gestation.

- **L3.5′ — Life (Aufhebung)** (`Sacrifice[F]` / `Word[E]`) — the cycle recognised as living; spiral not repetition.


## Derivation at this index

*Shares `L3`'s 8-fold and diatonic* — sounding Son·Image·Truth·Mind + Love·Work·Play·Need; anchors Logos, Word, Decision, Sacrifice; diatonic Logos–Son–Image · Work–Play–Need–Sacrifice.

*Reading:* grounded on Decision, the micro-cut becomes civilisational history; the matheme honours the diachronic lens but places its absolutising tendency — `#5` as harmony, not totalising synthesis.
